datasheet_id_and_revision: SLOS265F, August 1999, revised July 2024 (THS4021, THS4022; appended package option addendum 17-Sep-2026 and package materials 14-Oct-2026)
scope_of_this_file: Single-channel THS4021. The datasheet gives two separate characterizations: (1) 'THS4021D and THS4022DGN' (EC section 5.6 p6-p7, typical characteristics 5.8 p10-p15, Figs 5-1..5-31) and (2) 'THS4021DGN' (EC section 5.7 p8-p9, typical characteristics 5.9 p16-p20, Figs 5-32..5-56). Values are tagged 'D' (THS4021D, SOIC) or 'DGN' (THS4021DGN, PowerPAD HVSSOP) accordingly.
citation_convention: pN = 1-based PDF page index; printed page number equals N for p1-p28. EC = Electrical Characteristics table. Fig 5-N = datasheet figure number.
value_types: TYP = typical at TA = 25 C (all dynamic EC rows are TYP only). MIN/MAX = limits at 25 C or 'full range' (C-suffix 0-70 C, I-suffix -40-85 C); the datasheet does not state how limits are assured. CURVE = read from a typical-characteristic plot (uncertainty stated).
input_type: bipolar (complementary bipolar process >30 V, NPN and PNP with fT of several GHz; p21; simplified schematic Fig 6-3 shows a bipolar input pair)
compensation: decompensated voltage feedback ('configured in a decompensated voltage-feedback architecture', p21); offset-null pins 1 and 8

min_stable_gain.conditions: non-inverting gain >= +10 V/V, or inverting gain of -9 V/V or less (noise gain >= 10)
min_stable_gain.what_datasheet_says: p1: 'stable at gains of 10V/V or greater and -9V/V or less'; p21: 'stable with gain configurations of 10 V/V or greater'. No guidance for operation below the minimum gain, for capacitive (TIA) feedback or for noise-gain shaping. p23: for capacitive loads > 10 pF use a series isolation resistor (>= 20 Ohm; 75 Ohm in 75-Ohm systems).
min_stable_gain.derived_from_curve: From Fig 5-8 (D, +/-15 V): |AOL| = 20 dB at ~140 MHz where the AOL phase is ~-133 deg (=> ~47 deg phase margin at noise gain 10); AOL phase reaches -180 deg at ~320-360 MHz where |AOL| is still ~+11 dB. Derived reading, +/-5 deg.

open_loop_curve.phase_convention: phase of AOL, ~0 deg at 1 kHz and decreasing (plateau ~-90 deg, then to -240 deg at the bottom of the right axis); phase margin = 180 deg + phase at crossover. Right axis -240..+180 deg with 0 deg aligned to the 60 dB gridline.
open_loop_curve.reading_uncertainty: gain +/-1 dB; phase +/-3 deg below 300 MHz, +/-8 deg on the steep part above 300 MHz. Raster column digitizing of a 400-dpi render by curve colour, checked by eye.

packages.name: HVSSOP-8 PowerPAD (DGN; outlines DGN0008D and DGN0008H)
packages.ep_connection: Electrically isolated from all other pins; may be tied to any potential from VCC- to VCC+; typically connected to the ground plane for heat sinking (p25 Fig 7-3 note)
packages.notes: RthJC(top) 4.7 C/W; exposed pad 1.63-1.89 x 1.28-1.57 mm (DGN0008D, p35) or 1.1-1.8 x 1.01-1.71 mm (DGN0008H, p38) - which drawing applies is not stated; THS4021CDGN/CDGNR (0-70 C) and IDGN/IDGNR (-40-85 C) Active; THS4021DGN has its own EC table and curves (p8-p9, p16-p20)

pinout_notes: THS4021 (D and DGN): 1 NULL, 2 IN-, 3 IN+, 4 VCC-, 5 NC, 6 OUT, 7 VCC+, 8 NULL (p3). DGN thermal pad = pin 9 on the outline drawings.
tia_content_note: No transimpedance content. Front-page 'Simplified Application' is an inverting stage (50 Ohm input, 1 kOhm feedback, gain -20) with NULL pins; Fig 7-1 shows the same topology driving a capacitive load through 20 Ohm.
application_guidance: p23: series isolation resistor for CL > 10 pF (min 20 Ohm; 75 Ohm in 75-Ohm systems); Fig 7-2 single-pole RC at the non-inverting input. p24: 6.8-uF tantalum || 0.1-uF ceramic per supply pin (0.1 uF within 2.54 mm); remove ground plane near inputs and output; short input traces. p26 Fig 7-4: place RF/RG close to the pins; remove GND and power planes near input and output pins. p22: offset nulling with 10 kOhm pot on pins 1/8.
abs_max_and_input_protection: VCC- to VCC+ 33 V; VI +/-VCC; differential input voltage +/-1.5 V; continuous input current 10 mA; output current 240 mA (do not exceed TJ max); TJ 150 C; ESD HBM +/-1000 V, CDM +/-1000 V (p4). No input clamp network described.
other_notes: Two characterizations in one datasheet: THS4021D/THS4022DGN (p6-p7, Figs 5-1..5-31) vs THS4021DGN (p8-p9, Figs 5-32..5-56) with materially different numbers (Vn 1.2 vs 1.5 nV/rtHz; In 2.3 vs 2 pA/rtHz; IB 9 vs 3 uA; AOL 100 dB vs 60 V/mV; SSBW G=10 290 vs 350 MHz; RO 5 vs 13 Ohm; IO 200 mA at 10 Ohm vs 100 mA at 20 Ohm).
DGN noise curve (Fig 5-54) shows ~1.13-1.33 nV/rtHz and ~1.2-1.4 pA/rtHz at 10-100 kHz, below the DGN EC values (1.5 nV, 2 pA). D current-noise curve (Fig 5-12) shows ~2.1 pA/rtHz vs 2.3 in the EC.

DGN full-power bandwidth: 3.7 MHz (20 Vpp) and 11.8 MHz (5 Vpp) are half of SR/(2 pi VO(peak)) = 7.5 and 23.6 MHz computed with the listed slew rates; the D table (7.5, 23.6 MHz) is self-consistent with its note SR/(pi VO(PP)).
DGN EC (p8) THD and DG/DP conditions printed as 'gain = 2' although the part is stated stable only for gains >= 10 (D table uses gain = 10).
DGN output-swing rows 3-4 (p9) are printed with RL = 150 Ohm but give larger swing (+/-13.5, +/-3.8 V) than the RL = 250 / 150 Ohm rows; they match the D table's RL = 1 kOhm rows.
Fig 5-12 (current noise) caption lists 'RL = 150 Ohm, VOUT = 2 VPP' (copied plot conditions).
Fig 5-27 is captioned 'Input Offset Current vs Ambient Temperature' but shows a distribution histogram (mean 0.164, sigma 0.0395).
Device Information table (p1) lists THS4022 only in DGN, while the addendum lists active THS4022 SOIC (D) orderables.

Open-loop phase reaches -180 deg (~320-360 MHz) while |AOL| ~ +11 dB, i.e. not unity-gain stable; capacitive TIA feedback reduces the high-frequency noise gain toward 1 + C_in/C_F and must keep it >= ~10 at the loop crossover (consequence of the stated 10 V/V minimum gain; not discussed in the datasheet).
